@[inline] def my_refl {α : Type u} (a : α) : a = a :=
  congrArg (fun (_ : Prop) => a) (propext (Iff.intro (fun h => h) (fun h => h)))

inductive Err : Type where
  | NonFinite      : Err
  | InvalidConfig  : Err
  | ShapeMismatch  : Err
  | InvalidDimension : Err
  | InvalidLayerCount : Err
  | InvalidTolerance  : Err
  | DataLengthMismatch : Err
  | AliasedBuffers : Err
  | InvalidBatchSize : Err
  | InvalidModelState : Err
  | NumericFailure : Err
  | Overflow : Err
  | TooLarge : Err

inductive Result (α : Type) : Type where
  | ok  : α → Result α
  | err : Err → Result α

structure Shape where
  dims : List Nat

structure Tensor (F : Type) where
  shape      : Shape
  data       : List F
  storageId  : Nat
  storageOffset : Nat

structure NumOps (F : Type) where
  add      : F → F → F
  sub      : F → F → F
  mul      : F → F → F
  div      : F → F → F
  abs      : F → F
  lt       : F → F → Bool
  le       : F → F → Bool
  zero     : F
  one      : F
  clip_min : F
  clip_max : F
  isFinite : F → Bool
  lt_irrefl : ∀ a : F, lt a a = false
  lt_asymm : ∀ a b : F, lt a b = true → lt b a = false
  lt_trans : ∀ a b c : F, lt a b = true → lt b c = true → lt a c = true
  add_comm : ∀ a b : F, add a b = add b a
  add_assoc : ∀ a b c : F, add (add a b) c = add a (add b c)
  add_zero : ∀ a : F, add a zero = a
  zero_add : ∀ a : F, add zero a = a
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b : F, add (sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a b : F, div (mul a b) b = a
  div_mul_cancel : ∀ a b : F, mul (div a b) b = a
  abs_nonneg : ∀ a : F, le zero (abs a) = true
  clip_lt : lt clip_min clip_max = true
  isFinite_zero : isFinite zero = true
  isFinite_one : isFinite one = true

structure NumLaws (F : Type) (ops : NumOps F) where
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b : F, ops.add (ops.sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a b : F, ops.div (ops.mul a b) b = a

def bool_or_true_left (b : Bool) : (true || b) = true :=
  my_refl true

def bool_or_true_right (b : Bool) : (b || true) = true :=
  match b with
  | true => my_refl true
  | false => my_refl true

def bool_or_false_iff (a b : Bool) : (a || b) = false ↔ a = false ∧ b = false :=
  match a, b with
  | false, false => ⟨fun _ => ⟨my_refl false, my_refl false⟩, fun _ => my_refl false⟩
  | false, true => ⟨fun h => nomatch h, fun ⟨_, hb⟩ => nomatch hb⟩
  | true, _ => ⟨fun h => nomatch h, fun ⟨ha, _⟩ => nomatch ha⟩

def bool_and_true_iff (a b : Bool) : (a && b) = true ↔ a = true ∧ b = true :=
  match a, b with
  | true, true => ⟨fun _ => ⟨my_refl true, my_refl true⟩, fun _ => my_refl true⟩
  | true, false => ⟨fun h => nomatch h, fun ⟨_, hb⟩ => nomatch hb⟩
  | false, _ => ⟨fun h => nomatch h, fun ⟨ha, _⟩ => nomatch ha⟩

def clipF {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) : F :=
  if ops.lt x ops.clip_min then
    ops.clip_min
  else if ops.lt ops.clip_max x then
    ops.clip_max
  else
    x

def dgate {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) : F :=
  if ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x then
    ops.zero
  else
    ops.one

def tolOK {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x y abs_tol rel_tol : F) : Bool :=
  let diff := ops.abs (ops.sub x y)
  let scale := if ops.lt (ops.abs x) (ops.abs y) then ops.abs y else ops.abs x
  let bound := ops.add abs_tol (ops.mul rel_tol scale)
  ops.le diff bound

def ensureFiniteSlice {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : List F → Result Unit
  | [] => Result.ok ()
  | x :: xs =>
    match ops.isFinite x with
    | true => ensureFiniteSlice ops xs
    | false => Result.err Err.NonFinite

def validateClipRange {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (clip_min clip_max : F) : Result Unit :=
  match ops.isFinite clip_min, ops.isFinite clip_max with
  | true, true =>
    if ops.lt clip_min clip_max then
      Result.ok ()
    else
      Result.err Err.InvalidConfig
  | _, _ => Result.err Err.NonFinite

def validateComparisonTolerances {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (abs_tol rel_tol : F) : Result Unit :=
  match ops.isFinite abs_tol, ops.isFinite rel_tol with
  | true, true =>
    Result.ok ()
  | _, _ => Result.err Err.InvalidTolerance

def zeroList {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : Nat → List F
  | Nat.zero => []
  | Nat.succ n => ops.zero :: zeroList ops n

def validateTensor2D {F : Type} (t : Tensor F) : Result Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | [_, _] => Result.ok ()
  | _ => Result.err Err.ShapeMismatch

def validateTensor2DShape {F : Type} (t : Tensor F) (rows cols : Nat) : Result Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | [r, c] =>
    if r == rows && c == cols then
      Result.ok ()
    else
      Result.err Err.ShapeMismatch
  | _ => Result.err Err.ShapeMismatch

def validateModelConfigValues {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim num_layers : Nat) (cfg_clip_min cfg_clip_max : F) : Result Unit :=
  if dim == 0 then
    Result.err Err.InvalidDimension
  else if num_layers == 0 then
    Result.err Err.InvalidLayerCount
  else
    match validateClipRange ops cfg_clip_min cfg_clip_max with
    | Result.ok () => Result.ok ()
    | Result.err e => Result.err e

structure LayerCore (F : Type) where
  s_weight : Tensor F
  t_weight : Tensor F
  s_bias : Tensor F
  t_bias : Tensor F
  s_weight_grad : Option (Tensor F)
  t_weight_grad : Option (Tensor F)
  s_bias_grad : Option (Tensor F)
  t_bias_grad : Option (Tensor F)
  dim : Nat
  clip_min : F
  clip_max : F
  grad_mean : Bool

def LayerCore.invariant {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (layer : LayerCore F) : Prop :=
  layer.dim > 0 ∧
  layer.s_weight.shape.dims = [layer.dim, layer.dim] ∧
  layer.t_weight.shape.dims = [layer.dim, layer.dim] ∧
  layer.s_bias.shape.dims = [1, layer.dim] ∧
  layer.t_bias.shape.dims = [1, layer.dim] ∧
  layer.s_weight.data.length = layer.dim * layer.dim ∧
  layer.t_weight.data.length = layer.dim * layer.dim ∧
  layer.s_bias.data.length = layer.dim ∧
  layer.t_bias.data.length = layer.dim

def LayerCore.initOwned {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) (grad_mean : Bool) : Result (LayerCore F) :=
  if dim == 0 then
    Result.err Err.InvalidDimension
  else
    match validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max with
    | Result.err e => Result.err e
    | Result.ok () =>
      let s_w := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := zeroList ops (dim * dim), storageId := 1, storageOffset := 0 }
      let t_w := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := zeroList ops (dim * dim), storageId := 2, storageOffset := 0 }
      let s_b := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := zeroList ops dim, storageId := 3, storageOffset := 0 }
      let t_b := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := zeroList ops dim, storageId := 4, storageOffset := 0 }
      Result.ok {
        s_weight := s_w,
        t_weight := t_w,
        s_bias := s_b,
        t_bias := t_b,
        s_weight_grad := Option.none,
        t_weight_grad := Option.none,
        s_bias_grad := Option.none,
        t_bias_grad := Option.none,
        dim := dim,
        clip_min := clip_min,
        clip_max := clip_max,
        grad_mean := grad_mean
      }

def nat_eq_of_beq_eq_true : (n m : Nat) → (Nat.beq n m = true) → n = m
  | Nat.zero, Nat.zero, _ => my_refl Nat.zero
  | Nat.zero, Nat.succ _, h => nomatch h
  | Nat.succ _, Nat.zero, h => nomatch h
  | Nat.succ n, Nat.succ m, h =>
    let h_rec := nat_eq_of_beq_eq_true n m h
    congrArg Nat.succ h_rec

theorem clipF_lt {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h : ops.lt x ops.clip_min = true) : clipF ops x = ops.clip_min :=
  match h_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min with
  | true => my_refl ops.clip_min
  | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_match) h) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem clipF_gt {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h1 : ops.lt x ops.clip_min = false) (h2 : ops.lt ops.clip_max x = true) : clipF ops x = ops.clip_max :=
  match h1_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min with
  | false =>
    match h2_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
    | true => my_refl ops.clip_max
    | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem clipF_mid {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h1 : ops.lt x ops.clip_min = false) (h2 : ops.lt ops.clip_max x = false) : clipF ops x = x :=
  match h1_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min with
  | false =>
    match h2_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
    | false => my_refl x
    | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem clipF_idem {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) : clipF ops (clipF ops x) = clipF ops x :=
  match h1 : ops.lt x ops.clip_min, h2 : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
  | true, _ =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = ops.clip_min := clipF_lt ops x h1
    let h_lt_self := ops.lt_irrefl ops.clip_min
    let h_lt_max_min : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min = false := ops.lt_asymm ops.clip_min ops.clip_max ops.clip_lt
    let h_clip_min : clipF ops ops.clip_min = ops.clip_min :=
      match h_self_match : ops.lt ops.clip_min ops.clip_min with
      | false =>
        match h_max_min_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min with
        | false => my_refl ops.clip_min
        | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_max_min_match) h_lt_max_min) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_self_match) h_lt_self) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (clipF ops) h_clip_x) (Eq.trans h_clip_min (Eq.symm h_clip_x))
  | false, true =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = ops.clip_max := clipF_gt ops x h1 h2
    let h_lt_max_min : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min = false := ops.lt_asymm ops.clip_min ops.clip_max ops.clip_lt
    let h_lt_self := ops.lt_irrefl ops.clip_max
    let h_clip_max : clipF ops ops.clip_max = ops.clip_max :=
      match h_max_min_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min with
      | false =>
        match h_self_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_max with
        | false => my_refl ops.clip_max
        | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_self_match) h_lt_self) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_max_min_match) h_lt_max_min) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (clipF ops) h_clip_x) (Eq.trans h_clip_max (Eq.symm h_clip_x))
  | false, false =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = x := clipF_mid ops x h1 h2
    congrArg (clipF ops) h_clip_x

theorem dgate_outside {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h : (ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x) = true) : dgate ops x = ops.zero :=
  match h_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
  | true => my_refl ops.zero
  | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_match) h) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem dgate_inside {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h : (ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x) = false) : dgate ops x = ops.one :=
  match h_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
  | false => my_refl ops.one
  | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_match) h) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem dgate_clipF_inside {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) : dgate ops (clipF ops x) = ops.one :=
  match h1 : ops.lt x ops.clip_min, h2 : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
  | true, _ =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = ops.clip_min := clipF_lt ops x h1
    let h_lt_self := ops.lt_irrefl ops.clip_min
    let h_lt_max_min : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min = false := ops.lt_asymm ops.clip_min ops.clip_max ops.clip_lt
    let h_dgate_min : dgate ops ops.clip_min = ops.one :=
      match h_self_match : ops.lt ops.clip_min ops.clip_min, h_max_min_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min with
      | false, false => my_refl ops.one
      | true, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_self_match) h_lt_self) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | _, true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_max_min_match) h_lt_max_min) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (dgate ops) h_clip_x) h_dgate_min
  | false, true =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = ops.clip_max := clipF_gt ops x h1 h2
    let h_lt_max_min : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min = false := ops.lt_asymm ops.clip_min ops.clip_max ops.clip_lt
    let h_lt_self := ops.lt_irrefl ops.clip_max
    let h_dgate_max : dgate ops ops.clip_max = ops.one :=
      match h_max_min_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min, h_self_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_max with
      | false, false => my_refl ops.one
      | true, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_max_min_match) h_lt_max_min) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | _, true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_self_match) h_lt_self) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (dgate ops) h_clip_x) h_dgate_max
  | false, false =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = x := clipF_mid ops x h1 h2
    let h_dgate_x : dgate ops x = ops.one :=
      match h1_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min, h2_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
      | false, false => my_refl ops.one
      | true, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | _, true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (dgate ops) h_clip_x) h_dgate_x

theorem ensureFiniteSlice_ok {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : ∀ (L : List F), (∀ x ∈ L, ops.isFinite x = true) → ensureFiniteSlice ops L = Result.ok ()
  | [], _ => my_refl (Result.ok ())
  | x :: xs, h =>
    let h_x : ops.isFinite x = true := h x (List.Mem.head xs)
    let h_xs : ∀ y ∈ xs, ops.isFinite y = true := fun y hy => h y (List.Mem.tail x hy)
    match h_x_match : ops.isFinite x with
    | true => ensureFiniteSlice_ok ops xs h_xs
    | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_x_match) h_x) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem ensureFiniteSlice_err {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : ∀ (L : List F) (x : F), x ∈ L → ops.isFinite x = false → ensureFiniteSlice ops L = Result.err Err.NonFinite
  | x :: xs, _, List.Mem.head _, h_not =>
    match h_x_match : ops.isFinite x with
    | false => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)
    | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_x_match) h_not) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | y :: ys, x, List.Mem.tail _ hy, h_not =>
    match h_y_match : ops.isFinite y with
    | true => ensureFiniteSlice_err ops ys x hy h_not
    | false => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)

theorem length_zeroList {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : ∀ (n : Nat), (zeroList ops n).length = n
  | Nat.zero => my_refl 0
  | Nat.succ n => congrArg Nat.succ (length_zeroList ops n)

theorem zeroList_all_zero {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : ∀ (n : Nat) (x : F), x ∈ zeroList ops n → x = ops.zero
  | Nat.zero, _, h => nomatch h
  | Nat.succ n, x, h =>
    match h with
    | List.Mem.head _ => my_refl ops.zero
    | List.Mem.tail _ h_tail => zeroList_all_zero ops n x h_tail

theorem validateClipRange_ok {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (clip_min clip_max : F)
  (h1 : ops.isFinite clip_min = true) (h2 : ops.isFinite clip_max = true) (h3 : ops.lt clip_min clip_max = true) :
  validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max = Result.ok () :=
  match h1_match : ops.isFinite clip_min, h2_match : ops.isFinite clip_max with
  | true, true =>
    match h3_match : ops.lt clip_min clip_max with
    | true => my_refl (Result.ok ())
    | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h3_match) h3) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | false, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | _, false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem validateClipRange_err_nonfinite {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (clip_min clip_max : F)
  (h : ops.isFinite clip_min = false ∨ ops.isFinite clip_max = false) :
  validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max = Result.err Err.NonFinite :=
  match h with
  | Or.inl h1 =>
    match h1_match : ops.isFinite clip_min with
    | false => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)
    | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | Or.inr h2 =>
    match h1_match : ops.isFinite clip_min, h2_match : ops.isFinite clip_max with
    | true, false => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)
    | false, _ => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)
    | true, true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem validateClipRange_err_invalid {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (clip_min clip_max : F)
  (h1 : ops.isFinite clip_min = true) (h2 : ops.isFinite clip_max = true) (h3 : ops.lt clip_min clip_max = false) :
  validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max = Result.err Err.InvalidConfig :=
  match h1_match : ops.isFinite clip_min, h2_match : ops.isFinite clip_max with
  | true, true =>
    match h3_match : ops.lt clip_min clip_max with
    | false => my_refl (Result.err Err.InvalidConfig)
    | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h3_match) h3) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | false, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | _, false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem LayerCore_initOwned_invariant
    {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) (grad_mean : Bool)
    (h_dim : dim ≠ 0)
    (h_clip : validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max = Result.ok ()) :
    ∃ layer : LayerCore F,
      LayerCore.initOwned ops dim clip_min clip_max grad_mean = Result.ok layer ∧
      LayerCore.invariant ops layer :=
  match h_dim_match : dim == 0 with
  | true =>
    let h_eq := nat_eq_of_beq_eq_true dim 0 h_dim_match
    absurd h_eq h_dim
  | false =>
    match h_clip_match : validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max with
    | Result.ok () =>
      let s_w := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := zeroList ops (dim * dim), storageId := 1, storageOffset := 0 }
      let t_w := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := zeroList ops (dim * dim), storageId := 2, storageOffset := 0 }
      let s_b := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := zeroList ops dim, storageId := 3, storageOffset := 0 }
      let t_b := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := zeroList ops dim, storageId := 4, storageOffset := 0 }
      let layer : LayerCore F := {
        s_weight := s_w,
        t_weight := t_w,
        s_bias := s_b,
        t_bias := t_b,
        s_weight_grad := Option.none,
        t_weight_grad := Option.none,
        s_bias_grad := Option.none,
        t_bias_grad := Option.none,
        dim := dim,
        clip_min := clip_min,
        clip_max := clip_max,
        grad_mean := grad_mean
      }
      let h_dim_gt : dim > 0 :=
        match dim with
        | Nat.zero => nomatch h_dim (my_refl 0)
        | Nat.succ _ => Nat.succ_pos _
      let h_inv : LayerCore.invariant ops layer :=
        ⟨h_dim_gt,
         my_refl _, my_refl _, my_refl _, my_refl _,
         length_zeroList ops (dim * dim),
         length_zeroList ops (dim * dim),
         length_zeroList ops dim,
         length_zeroList ops dim⟩
      Exists.intro layer ⟨my_refl _, h_inv⟩
    | Result.err e => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_clip_match) h_clip) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

def computeScaleRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (s_weight : Tensor F) (s_bias : Tensor F) (clip_min clip_max : F) (input_row : List F) : List F :=
  List.map (fun x => ops.exp (clipF ops x)) input_row

def computeTranslationRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (t_weight : Tensor F) (t_bias : Tensor F) (input_row : List F) : List F :=
  List.map (fun x => ops.add x ops.one) input_row

theorem inverseRow_left_inverse {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (laws : NumLaws F ops) (x scale_val : F) :
  ops.div (ops.mul x scale_val) scale_val = x :=
  laws.mul_div_cancel x scale_val

theorem translation_cancel {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (laws : NumLaws F ops) (y2 trans : F) :
  ops.add (ops.sub y2 trans) trans = y2 :=
  laws.add_sub_cancel y2 trans

inductive Result (α : Type) : Type where
  | ok  : α → Result α
  | err : Err → Result α

structure Shape where
  dims : List Nat

structure Tensor (F : Type) where
  shape      : Shape
  data       : List F
  storageId  : Nat
  storageOffset : Nat

structure NumOps (F : Type) where
  add      : F → F → F
  sub      : F → F → F
  mul      : F → F → F
  div      : F → F → F
  abs      : F → F
  lt       : F → F → Bool
  le       : F → F → Bool
  zero     : F
  one      : F
  clip_min : F
  clip_max : F
  isFinite : F → Bool
  lt_irrefl : ∀ a : F, lt a a = false
  lt_asymm : ∀ a b : F, lt a b = true → lt b a = false
  lt_trans : ∀ a b c : F, lt a b = true → lt b c = true → lt a c = true
  add_comm : ∀ a b : F, add a b = add b a
  add_assoc : ∀ a b c : F, add (add a b) c = add a (add b c)
  add_zero : ∀ a : F, add a zero = a
  zero_add : ∀ a : F, add zero a = a
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b : F, add (sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a b : F, div (mul a b) b = a
  div_mul_cancel : ∀ a b : F, mul (div a b) b = a
  abs_nonneg : ∀ a : F, le zero (abs a) = true
  clip_lt : lt clip_min clip_max = true
  isFinite_zero : isFinite zero = true
  isFinite_one : isFinite one = true

structure NumLaws (F : Type) (ops : NumOps F) where
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b : F, ops.add (ops.sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a b : F, ops.div (ops.mul a b) b = a

def bool_or_true_left (b : Bool) : (true || b) = true :=
  my_refl true

def bool_or_true_right (b : Bool) : (b || true) = true :=
  match b with
  | true => my_refl true
  | false => my_refl true

def bool_or_false_iff (a b : Bool) : (a || b) = false ↔ a = false ∧ b = false :=
  match a, b with
  | false, false => ⟨fun _ => ⟨my_refl false, my_refl false⟩, fun _ => my_refl false⟩
  | false, true => ⟨fun h => nomatch h, fun ⟨_, hb⟩ => nomatch hb⟩
  | true, _ => ⟨fun h => nomatch h, fun ⟨ha, _⟩ => nomatch ha⟩

def bool_and_true_iff (a b : Bool) : (a && b) = true ↔ a = true ∧ b = true :=
  match a, b with
  | true, true => ⟨fun _ => ⟨my_refl true, my_refl true⟩, fun _ => my_refl true⟩
  | true, false => ⟨fun h => nomatch h, fun ⟨_, hb⟩ => nomatch hb⟩
  | false, _ => ⟨fun h => nomatch h, fun ⟨ha, _⟩ => nomatch ha⟩

def clipF {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) : F :=
  if ops.lt x ops.clip_min then
    ops.clip_min
  else if ops.lt ops.clip_max x then
    ops.clip_max
  else
    x

def dgate {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) : F :=
  if ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x then
    ops.zero
  else
    ops.one

def tolOK {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x y abs_tol rel_tol : F) : Bool :=
  let diff := ops.abs (ops.sub x y)
  let scale := if ops.lt (ops.abs x) (ops.abs y) then ops.abs y else ops.abs x
  let bound := ops.add abs_tol (ops.mul rel_tol scale)
  ops.le diff bound

def ensureFiniteSlice {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : List F → Result Unit
  | [] => Result.ok ()
  | x :: xs =>
    match ops.isFinite x with
    | true => ensureFiniteSlice ops xs
    | false => Result.err Err.NonFinite

def validateClipRange {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (clip_min clip_max : F) : Result Unit :=
  match ops.isFinite clip_min, ops.isFinite clip_max with
  | true, true =>
    if ops.lt clip_min clip_max then
      Result.ok ()
    else
      Result.err Err.InvalidConfig
  | _, _ => Result.err Err.NonFinite

def validateComparisonTolerances {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (abs_tol rel_tol : F) : Result Unit :=
  match ops.isFinite abs_tol, ops.isFinite rel_tol with
  | true, true =>
    Result.ok ()
  | _, _ => Result.err Err.InvalidTolerance

def zeroList {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : Nat → List F
  | Nat.zero => []
  | Nat.succ n => ops.zero :: zeroList ops n

def validateTensor2D {F : Type} (t : Tensor F) : Result Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | [_, _] => Result.ok ()
  | _ => Result.err Err.ShapeMismatch

def validateTensor2DShape {F : Type} (t : Tensor F) (rows cols : Nat) : Result Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | [r, c] =>
    if r == rows && c == cols then
      Result.ok ()
    else
      Result.err Err.ShapeMismatch
  | _ => Result.err Err.ShapeMismatch

def validateModelConfigValues {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim num_layers : Nat) (cfg_clip_min cfg_clip_max : F) : Result Unit :=
  if dim == 0 then
    Result.err Err.InvalidDimension
  else if num_layers == 0 then
    Result.err Err.InvalidLayerCount
  else
    match validateClipRange ops cfg_clip_min cfg_clip_max with
    | Result.ok () => Result.ok ()
    | Result.err e => Result.err e

structure LayerCore (F : Type) where
  s_weight : Tensor F
  t_weight : Tensor F
  s_bias : Tensor F
  t_bias : Tensor F
  s_weight_grad : Option (Tensor F)
  t_weight_grad : Option (Tensor F)
  s_bias_grad : Option (Tensor F)
  t_bias_grad : Option (Tensor F)
  dim : Nat
  clip_min : F
  clip_max : F
  grad_mean : Bool

def LayerCore.invariant {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (layer : LayerCore F) : Prop :=
  layer.dim > 0 ∧
  layer.s_weight.shape.dims = [layer.dim, layer.dim] ∧
  layer.t_weight.shape.dims = [layer.dim, layer.dim] ∧
  layer.s_bias.shape.dims = [1, layer.dim] ∧
  layer.t_bias.shape.dims = [1, layer.dim] ∧
  layer.s_weight.data.length = layer.dim * layer.dim ∧
  layer.t_weight.data.length = layer.dim * layer.dim ∧
  layer.s_bias.data.length = layer.dim ∧
  layer.t_bias.data.length = layer.dim

def LayerCore.initOwned {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) (grad_mean : Bool) : Result (LayerCore F) :=
  if dim == 0 then
    Result.err Err.InvalidDimension
  else
    match validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max with
    | Result.err e => Result.err e
    | Result.ok () =>
      let s_w := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := zeroList ops (dim * dim), storageId := 1, storageOffset := 0 }
      let t_w := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := zeroList ops (dim * dim), storageId := 2, storageOffset := 0 }
      let s_b := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := zeroList ops dim, storageId := 3, storageOffset := 0 }
      let t_b := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := zeroList ops dim, storageId := 4, storageOffset := 0 }
      Result.ok {
        s_weight := s_w,
        t_weight := t_w,
        s_bias := s_b,
        t_bias := t_b,
        s_weight_grad := Option.none,
        t_weight_grad := Option.none,
        s_bias_grad := Option.none,
        t_bias_grad := Option.none,
        dim := dim,
        clip_min := clip_min,
        clip_max := clip_max,
        grad_mean := grad_mean
      }

def nat_eq_of_beq_eq_true : (n m : Nat) → (Nat.beq n m = true) → n = m
  | Nat.zero, Nat.zero, _ => my_refl Nat.zero
  | Nat.zero, Nat.succ _, h => nomatch h
  | Nat.succ _, Nat.zero, h => nomatch h
  | Nat.succ n, Nat.succ m, h =>
    let h_rec := nat_eq_of_beq_eq_true n m h
    congrArg Nat.succ h_rec

theorem clipF_lt {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h : ops.lt x ops.clip_min = true) : clipF ops x = ops.clip_min :=
  match h_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min with
  | true => my_refl ops.clip_min
  | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_match) h) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem clipF_gt {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h1 : ops.lt x ops.clip_min = false) (h2 : ops.lt ops.clip_max x = true) : clipF ops x = ops.clip_max :=
  match h1_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min with
  | false =>
    match h2_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
    | true => my_refl ops.clip_max
    | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem clipF_mid {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h1 : ops.lt x ops.clip_min = false) (h2 : ops.lt ops.clip_max x = false) : clipF ops x = x :=
  match h1_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min with
  | false =>
    match h2_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
    | false => my_refl x
    | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem clipF_idem {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) : clipF ops (clipF ops x) = clipF ops x :=
  match h1 : ops.lt x ops.clip_min, h2 : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
  | true, _ =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = ops.clip_min := clipF_lt ops x h1
    let h_lt_self := ops.lt_irrefl ops.clip_min
    let h_lt_max_min : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min = false := ops.lt_asymm ops.clip_min ops.clip_max ops.clip_lt
    let h_clip_min : clipF ops ops.clip_min = ops.clip_min :=
      match h_self_match : ops.lt ops.clip_min ops.clip_min with
      | false =>
        match h_max_min_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min with
        | false => my_refl ops.clip_min
        | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_max_min_match) h_lt_max_min) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_self_match) h_lt_self) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (clipF ops) h_clip_x) (Eq.trans h_clip_min (Eq.symm h_clip_x))
  | false, true =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = ops.clip_max := clipF_gt ops x h1 h2
    let h_lt_max_min : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min = false := ops.lt_asymm ops.clip_min ops.clip_max ops.clip_lt
    let h_lt_self := ops.lt_irrefl ops.clip_max
    let h_clip_max : clipF ops ops.clip_max = ops.clip_max :=
      match h_max_min_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min with
      | false =>
        match h_self_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_max with
        | false => my_refl ops.clip_max
        | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_self_match) h_lt_self) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_max_min_match) h_lt_max_min) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (clipF ops) h_clip_x) (Eq.trans h_clip_max (Eq.symm h_clip_x))
  | false, false =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = x := clipF_mid ops x h1 h2
    congrArg (clipF ops) h_clip_x

theorem dgate_outside {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h : (ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x) = true) : dgate ops x = ops.zero :=
  match h_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
  | true => my_refl ops.zero
  | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_match) h) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem dgate_inside {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) (h : (ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x) = false) : dgate ops x = ops.one :=
  match h_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min || ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
  | false => my_refl ops.one
  | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_match) h) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem dgate_clipF_inside {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (x : F) : dgate ops (clipF ops x) = ops.one :=
  match h1 : ops.lt x ops.clip_min, h2 : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
  | true, _ =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = ops.clip_min := clipF_lt ops x h1
    let h_lt_self := ops.lt_irrefl ops.clip_min
    let h_lt_max_min : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min = false := ops.lt_asymm ops.clip_min ops.clip_max ops.clip_lt
    let h_dgate_min : dgate ops ops.clip_min = ops.one :=
      match h_self_match : ops.lt ops.clip_min ops.clip_min, h_max_min_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min with
      | false, false => my_refl ops.one
      | true, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_self_match) h_lt_self) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | _, true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_max_min_match) h_lt_max_min) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (dgate ops) h_clip_x) h_dgate_min
  | false, true =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = ops.clip_max := clipF_gt ops x h1 h2
    let h_lt_max_min : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min = false := ops.lt_asymm ops.clip_min ops.clip_max ops.clip_lt
    let h_lt_self := ops.lt_irrefl ops.clip_max
    let h_dgate_max : dgate ops ops.clip_max = ops.one :=
      match h_max_min_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_min, h_self_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max ops.clip_max with
      | false, false => my_refl ops.one
      | true, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_max_min_match) h_lt_max_min) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | _, true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_self_match) h_lt_self) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (dgate ops) h_clip_x) h_dgate_max
  | false, false =>
    let h_clip_x : clipF ops x = x := clipF_mid ops x h1 h2
    let h_dgate_x : dgate ops x = ops.one :=
      match h1_match : ops.lt x ops.clip_min, h2_match : ops.lt ops.clip_max x with
      | false, false => my_refl ops.one
      | true, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
      | _, true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
    Eq.trans (congrArg (dgate ops) h_clip_x) h_dgate_x

theorem ensureFiniteSlice_ok {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : ∀ (L : List F), (∀ x ∈ L, ops.isFinite x = true) → ensureFiniteSlice ops L = Result.ok ()
  | [], _ => my_refl (Result.ok ())
  | x :: xs, h =>
    let h_x : ops.isFinite x = true := h x (List.Mem.head xs)
    let h_xs : ∀ y ∈ xs, ops.isFinite y = true := fun y hy => h y (List.Mem.tail x hy)
    match h_x_match : ops.isFinite x with
    | true => ensureFiniteSlice_ok ops xs h_xs
    | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_x_match) h_x) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem ensureFiniteSlice_err {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : ∀ (L : List F) (x : F), x ∈ L → ops.isFinite x = false → ensureFiniteSlice ops L = Result.err Err.NonFinite
  | x :: xs, _, List.Mem.head _, h_not =>
    match h_x_match : ops.isFinite x with
    | false => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)
    | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_x_match) h_not) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | y :: ys, x, List.Mem.tail _ hy, h_not =>
    match h_y_match : ops.isFinite y with
    | true => ensureFiniteSlice_err ops ys x hy h_not
    | false => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)

theorem length_zeroList {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : ∀ (n : Nat), (zeroList ops n).length = n
  | Nat.zero => my_refl 0
  | Nat.succ n => congrArg Nat.succ (length_zeroList ops n)

theorem zeroList_all_zero {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : ∀ (n : Nat) (x : F), x ∈ zeroList ops n → x = ops.zero
  | Nat.zero, _, h => nomatch h
  | Nat.succ n, x, h =>
    match h with
    | List.Mem.head _ => my_refl ops.zero
    | List.Mem.tail _ h_tail => zeroList_all_zero ops n x h_tail

theorem validateClipRange_ok {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (clip_min clip_max : F)
  (h1 : ops.isFinite clip_min = true) (h2 : ops.isFinite clip_max = true) (h3 : ops.lt clip_min clip_max = true) :
  validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max = Result.ok () :=
  match h1_match : ops.isFinite clip_min, h2_match : ops.isFinite clip_max with
  | true, true =>
    match h3_match : ops.lt clip_min clip_max with
    | true => my_refl (Result.ok ())
    | false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h3_match) h3) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | false, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | _, false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem validateClipRange_err_nonfinite {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (clip_min clip_max : F)
  (h : ops.isFinite clip_min = false ∨ ops.isFinite clip_max = false) :
  validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max = Result.err Err.NonFinite :=
  match h with
  | Or.inl h1 =>
    match h1_match : ops.isFinite clip_min with
    | false => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)
    | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | Or.inr h2 =>
    match h1_match : ops.isFinite clip_min, h2_match : ops.isFinite clip_max with
    | true, false => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)
    | false, _ => my_refl (Result.err Err.NonFinite)
    | true, true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem validateClipRange_err_invalid {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (clip_min clip_max : F)
  (h1 : ops.isFinite clip_min = true) (h2 : ops.isFinite clip_max = true) (h3 : ops.lt clip_min clip_max = false) :
  validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max = Result.err Err.InvalidConfig :=
  match h1_match : ops.isFinite clip_min, h2_match : ops.isFinite clip_max with
  | true, true =>
    match h3_match : ops.lt clip_min clip_max with
    | false => my_refl (Result.err Err.InvalidConfig)
    | true => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h3_match) h3) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | false, _ => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h1_match) h1) (fun hc => nomatch hc)
  | _, false => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h2_match) h2) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

theorem LayerCore_initOwned_invariant
    {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) (grad_mean : Bool)
    (h_dim : dim ≠ 0)
    (h_clip : validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max = Result.ok ()) :
    ∃ layer : LayerCore F,
      LayerCore.initOwned ops dim clip_min clip_max grad_mean = Result.ok layer ∧
      LayerCore.invariant ops layer :=
  match h_dim_match : dim == 0 with
  | true =>
    let h_eq := nat_eq_of_beq_eq_true dim 0 h_dim_match
    absurd h_eq h_dim
  | false =>
    match h_clip_match : validateClipRange ops clip_min clip_max with
    | Result.ok () =>
      let s_w := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := zeroList ops (dim * dim), storageId := 1, storageOffset := 0 }
      let t_w := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := zeroList ops (dim * dim), storageId := 2, storageOffset := 0 }
      let s_b := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := zeroList ops dim, storageId := 3, storageOffset := 0 }
      let t_b := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := zeroList ops dim, storageId := 4, storageOffset := 0 }
      let layer : LayerCore F := {
        s_weight := s_w,
        t_weight := t_w,
        s_bias := s_b,
        t_bias := t_b,
        s_weight_grad := Option.none,
        t_weight_grad := Option.none,
        s_bias_grad := Option.none,
        t_bias_grad := Option.none,
        dim := dim,
        clip_min := clip_min,
        clip_max := clip_max,
        grad_mean := grad_mean
      }
      let h_dim_gt : dim > 0 :=
        match dim with
        | Nat.zero => nomatch h_dim (my_refl 0)
        | Nat.succ _ => Nat.succ_pos _
      let h_inv : LayerCore.invariant ops layer :=
        ⟨h_dim_gt,
         my_refl _, my_refl _, my_refl _, my_refl _,
         length_zeroList ops (dim * dim),
         length_zeroList ops (dim * dim),
         length_zeroList ops dim,
         length_zeroList ops dim⟩
      Exists.intro layer ⟨my_refl _, h_inv⟩
    | Result.err e => absurd (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_clip_match) h_clip) (fun hc => nomatch hc)

def computeScaleRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (s_weight : Tensor F) (s_bias : Tensor F) (clip_min clip_max : F) (input_row : List F) : List F :=
  List.map (fun x => ops.exp (clipF ops x)) input_row

def computeTranslationRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (t_weight : Tensor F) (t_bias : Tensor F) (input_row : List F) : List F :=
  List.map (fun x => ops.add x ops.one) input_row

theorem inverseRow_left_inverse {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (laws : NumLaws F ops) (x scale_val : F) :
  ops.div (ops.mul x scale_val) scale_val = x :=
  laws.mul_div_cancel x scale_val

theorem translation_cancel {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (laws : NumLaws F ops) (y2 trans : F) :
  ops.add (ops.sub y2 trans) trans = y2 :=
  laws.add_sub_cancel y2 trans

A beküldött Lean 4 fájl **nem valósít meg teljes, valós formális verifikációt** a Zig forráshoz — ez egy részleges, félkész bizonyítás, amely a triviális segédfüggvényeket rendben lefedi, de a Zig kód tényleges kritikus logikáját (a forward/inverse rétegszámítást és annak invertálhatóságát) egyáltalán nem modellezi, és emellett egy fordítási hibát is tartalmaz.

## Fordítási hiba: `ops.exp` nem létezik

A `computeScaleRow` függvény `ops.exp (clipF ops x)`-et hív, de a `NumOps F` struktúra mezői között (`add, sub, mul, div, abs, lt, le, zero, one, clip_min, clip_max, isFinite`, valamint a törvénymezők) **nincs `exp` mező definiálva**. Ez azt jelenti, hogy a fájl a jelen formájában **nem fordul le** — ez alapfeltétele lenne bármilyen "valós" verifikációnak, tehát ez már önmagában diszkvalifikálja a beadványt.[1]

## A lényegi Zig-logika hiányzik a bizonyításból

## Állapot

A hibalistában szerepel a legelső alaplemma (`my_refl`) hibás típuskövetkeztetése, több rosszul megadott `Iff.intro`-konstrukció, sok olyan hely, ahol `my_refl` definíciós egyenlőség helyett nem illeszkedő célra van ráerőltetve, továbbá hiányzó vagy hibás segédlemmák, például `nat_succ_inj`.[1]

A mentés/betöltés résznél a fájl Lean-szinten hibásan kezeli a `UInt32`/`UInt64` mezőelérést (`.val`), hibás `Float.bits` és `Float.mk` használatot tartalmaz, sőt a hibalista fordítói pánikot is mutat `Float` literál/reprezentáció környékén, ami azt jelzi, hogy ez a rész nem egyszerű javítgatás, hanem újratervezést igényel a Lean elérhető primitívjeihez igazítva.[1]
